findings.title: getForLogin ignores organization invalidations, serving stale login lists
findings.body: getForLogin() only checks isInvalid(cacheKey) for the per-FetchMode key, while getByOrganization() in the same file checks isInvalid(cacheKey) || isInvalid(orgId). Linking/unlinking an IDP to an organization, removing an organization, or updating an organization via OrganizationProvider invalidates the org/orgId entries, not the .idp.login keys. A cached getForLogin(ORG_ONLY/ALL, orgId) list of internalIds will therefore not be refreshed and the login page will show removed/unlinked brokers or miss newly linked public brokers until natural eviction.

findings.title: getLoginPredicate dereferences possibly-null IDP config
findings.body: LoginFilter.getLoginPredicate() now evaluates idp.getConfig().get(OrganizationModel.BROKER_PUBLIC). If an IdentityProviderModel has a null config map the call throws NullPointerException. The predicate is invoked on every create/remove/update invalidation path in InfinispanIdentityProviderStorageProvider (registerIDPLoginInvalidation / registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate), so a single IDP with null config breaks IDP writes with a 500 instead of correctly deciding to (not) invalidate the login caches.
